# Synthetic Office object fixtures

Generated by `scripts/acceptance/008_generate_object_fixtures.py` in a separate SDK environment. `manifest.json` records every original SHA, expected supported text, drawing parts, embedded PNGs, generator SHA and exact SDK versions. The generator independently reopens each package, validates internal relationship targets and actual nonblank PNGs, and checks empty/text source values. Tests use these frozen bytes; python-docx and openpyxl are not SMM or CI test dependencies.

Ordinary/global each contain DOCX body/header/footer picture-only inputs, XLSX image-only input, and real blank / supported-text-plus-picture controls. They are synthetic and contain no user data. No standalone image support is added.

Sources: [python-docx 1.2.0](https://pypi.org/project/python-docx/1.2.0/), [openpyxl 3.1.5](https://pypi.org/project/openpyxl/3.1.5/), [Word sections](https://python-docx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/section.html), [spreadsheet image generation](https://openpyxl.readthedocs.io/en/stable/images.html).

To regenerate, use a separate environment with `python-docx==1.2.0 openpyxl==3.1.5 Pillow==13.0.0 lxml==6.1.3`, then run `python scripts/acceptance/008_generate_object_fixtures.py tests/fixtures/document-format-objects`. Regeneration intentionally updates the frozen manifest and must be reviewed with changed inputs. The root `.gitattributes` retains this generator as LF and these Office files as binary for consistent checkout SHA checks.
